notes: 8 configurations from 8 manufacturers (Quantum Design, Anton Paar, Montana Instruments, NETZSCH, Oxford Cryosystems, attocube, Cryogenic Ltd, SP Industries), none duplicating data/cryostats. Accessed 2026-11-01. All values are manufacturer specifications quoted from datasheets/product pages; PDF tables extracted with pdftotext, quotes keep the printed label-value text. Conservative choices: CryoAdvance '<3.2 K' stored as 3.2 K; attoDRY2100 base '1.65 .. 1.8 K (standard inserts)' stored as 1.8 K for both range lo and base; CFMS stability stored as the worst value (50 mK at 300 K); TTK 600 '2 bar above atmospheric' stored as 200000 Pa; CharpyCool usable depth = 22.9 cm - 1.9 cm stirrer = 21.0 cm. Sample spaces filled with helium exchange/flow gas (MPMS 3, attoDRY2100, CFMS VTI) are recorded as vacuum.available=false and pressure.base=not_available citing the sample-environment statement. Magnet / wiring / window absences for the XRD chamber, dilatometer and Charpy bath cite the complete specification table of each product (no magnet, no sample feedthroughs listed); XRD chambers (TTK 600, PheniX) have only X-ray windows, so optical_access is left in not_found rather than guessed. Options present in the family but not fitted are optional_not_installed (MPMS 3 FOSH/ETO, CryoAdvance magnet, TTK 600 battery holder, attoDRY2100 optical/transport inserts, CFMS optical base, heat capacity, He-3). Uses proposed v4 key chamber.volume (CharpyCool) in addition to existing keys. Tavily quota was exhausted; sources were read with WebFetch/WebSearch and the built-in browser (read-only).
